title: PolyProPicks Automation Roadmap Delta
description: One evidence-based proposed change to the Evolution Automation Roadmap, produced by the Automation Roadmap Governor. Enforced by scripts/control-plane/lib/evolution-governor.mjs — a focused dependency-free validator, not a generic JSON Schema engine. A delta is always a proposal: it can never accept itself, and it can never touch Axis A priority, product-roadmap phase, live-money gates, risk authority, strategic stage order, accepted capability level or promotion rules.

based_on_cycles.description: cycle_id values of the persisted, validated Evolution cycles this delta is derived from. Never invented — every id must resolve to a cycle file under evolution/cycles/.

current_stage.description: Must match one of the exactly three approved AUTOMATION_ROADMAP.yaml levels. The Governor never invents a fourth stage.

proposed_change.description: The concrete change proposed within the Evolution roadmap only — never a change to the product roadmap.

preserves.description: What explicitly stays unchanged, at minimum the Axis A priority invariant.

business_effect.description: Effect on Axis A — launch, revenue, settlement, reconciled PnL. May state 'none'. Must never claim to reorder Axis A below Axis B.

manifest_2_effect.description: Effect on Axis B — reusable Manifest 2 / Agent Operating System capability. May state 'none'.

evidence.description: Every material claim behind this delta must carry at least one evidence reference to a persisted cycle, PR, SHA or completion envelope.

opportunity_cost.description: What is not done, or done later, because this change is made. Never 'none' without justification — an automation delta always displaces something.

drift_from_original_roadmap.description: How far this change moves from the roadmap approved in AUTOMATION_ROADMAP.yaml. 'none' is a valid value when the change is purely factual.

success_metric.description: An observable metric that would show this change worked.

rollback_condition.description: An observable condition under which this change is reverted.

accepted.description: A roadmap delta is a proposal only. The Governor must never set this true — acceptance is a separate Architect/Promotion Gate step.

x-invariants: accepted must be false — the Governor never accepts its own delta.
current_stage must be one of the exactly three approved AUTOMATION_ROADMAP.yaml levels.
business_effect must never state or imply that Axis A drops below Axis B in priority.

The delta object may never carry a key that mutates PnL priority, product-roadmap phase, live-money gates, risk authority, strategic stage order, accepted capability level or promotion rules — those require a separate Promotion Gate.
based_on_cycles must be non-empty and every id must resolve to a persisted, validated cycle.
Every evidence entry is a material claim and carries at least one evidence reference.
